channel.title: KidharMilega Blog — ODOP Business Stories & Guides
channel.description: ODOP products, district business ideas aur sarkari schemes par KidharMilega ke articles.

item.title: MSME Registration Benefits in Hindi: उद्यम रजिस्ट्रेशन के फायदे (सब्सिडी, सस्ता लोन, सरकारी टेंडर और 45 दिन में पेमेंट)
item.description: Udyam (MSME) registration की कोई फीस नहीं लगती। इससे बिना गारंटी CGTMSE loan, 45 दिन में payment का कानूनी हक, tender में EMD छूट और PMEGP/PMFME/ZED जैसी schemes की eligibility मिलती है। हर फायदा रुपये के हिसाब से समझो, साथ में 2026 Amendment Act के बदलाव भी।

item.title: SBI e Mudra Loan 8044: How to Apply Online for Up to ₹50,000, Plus Bank of Baroda and PNB e-Mudra Compared
item.description: "8044" isn't a new loan scheme. It's the port number in the address of SBI's e-Mudra portal. This guide gives the correct link, the full application steps, the real ₹50,000 and ₹1 lakh limits, and how SBI compares with Bank of Baroda and PNB.

item.title: Phulkari GI Tag: What It Protects, Who Can Use It and How to Start a Phulkari Business in Punjab
item.description: Phulkari's GI tag was issued on 22 October 2010 (certificate no. 145). It is held by PSIEC, covers Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan, and is valid until 13 March 2035. This guide covers what the tag protects, how to become an authorised user, and indicative costs and margins on dupattas and suits.

item.title: PMEGP Loan Interest Rate Calculator 2026: Subsidy, EMI, Documents, Apply Online Login and Status
item.description: PMEGP has no fixed interest rate. Lender guides quote about 11–12% (unofficial), and a 15–35% margin-money subsidy shrinks the amount you actually repay. This calculator shows your subsidy, your own contribution and your EMI, with a worked Gujarat example, the document list and how to log in and check status on the KVIC portal.

item.title: PM Mudra Loan Yojana in Hindi: PM मुद्रा लोन योजना 2026 – शिशु, किशोर, तरुण, तरुण प्लस, ब्याज दर, आयु सीमा और जन समर्थ पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन आवेदन
item.description: PM मुद्रा लोन योजना में बिना गारंटी ₹20 लाख तक का बिज़नेस लोन मिलता है। ₹20 लाख वाला तरुण प्लस लोन सिर्फ उन्हें मिलता है जो पहले तरुण लोन चुका चुके हैं। इस गाइड में चारों कैटेगरी, आयु सीमा, बैंक-वार ब्याज दर (7 अक्टूबर 2026 की repo hike के बाद), जन समर्थ और Bank of Baroda पर आवेदन के steps, और फर्जी लोन लेटर से बचने के तरीके हैं।

item.title: PMEGP Loan Process in Hindi: PMEGP लोन कैसे लें, नया पोर्टल, सब्सिडी, दस्तावेज़ और स्टेप-बाय-स्टेप आवेदन (2026)
item.description: PMEGP के आवेदन अब पुराने KVIC पोर्टल पर नहीं, नए pmegp.msme.gov.in पोर्टल पर होते हैं। इस गाइड में Udyam रजिस्ट्रेशन से लेकर सब्सिडी रिलीज़ तक हर स्टेप हिंदी में है, साथ में ₹10 लाख की ODOP यूनिट का पूरा हिसाब।

item.title: Union Bank e Mudra Loan 50,000: How to Apply Online for the Shishu Mudra Loan (Eligibility, Documents, EMI)
item.description: Union Bank's "e-Mudra" loan is officially its Shishu Mudra Straight Through Processing loan. It lends up to ₹50,000 without collateral, you apply online, and only existing Union Bank customers can use it. This guide gives the exact apply link, the documents you need, example EMIs at today's 8.25% EBLR, and how to spot a fake approval letter.

item.title: PM Vishwakarma Yojana Online Apply 2024 (Updated November 2026): CSC Steps, ₹15,000 Toolkit, ₹3 Lakh Loan and the 18 Trades
item.description: You still apply for PM Vishwakarma Yojana through a CSC, using Aadhaar biometrics and a mobile OTP, and it costs nothing. This November 2026 guide covers the 18 trades, the ₹15,000 toolkit, the ₹3 lakh loan at 5%, the ODOP crafts that qualify, the official helpline and where West Bengal stands now.

item.title: Mudra Loan Project Report Format, With a Filled ₹5 Lakh Food-Processing Sample
item.description: A free Mudra loan project report format you can copy, plus a filled sample for a ₹5 lakh pickle unit with project cost, a 3-year P&L, break-even and DSCR. It also covers what banks check and where to apply.

item.title: How to Identify If the Pashmina Shawl I Am Buying Is Genuine? GI Label, Burn Test, Price Checks (and What 'Pashmoda' Means)
item.description: Is that "pure pashmina" really pashmina? Here's a 7-step checklist: the official proofs (the Kashmir GI QR label, the WII certification tag, BIS IS 17269), what home tests can and can't tell you, realistic prices, what "pashmoda" and "pashmina saree" listings really are, and how resellers can source genuine stock.

item.title: How to Update IEC Code on DGFT (2026): Annual Update, Activation and Verification
item.description: The annual IEC update is free. Log in at dgft.gov.in, open Update/Modify IEC, check every section and sign with a DSC or Aadhaar OTP. Filing that same update also reactivates an IEC that was deactivated after the 30 June deadline. Here's the full path, the NPCI bank check that's causing failures, and how to verify any IEC.

item.title: FSSAI License Number Search by Name: How to Check if a Food Licence Is Real or Fake (2026 Guide)
item.description: You can do an FSSAI license number search by name for free on FSSAI's FoSCoS portal. Enter the business's legal name, state and district, then compare the status, address and product categories. Here are the steps, 7 signs of a fake licence, and the 2026 rule changes.

item.title: 18 Small Business Ideas From Home in India: ₹ Setup Costs, Licences and Your District's ODOP Product
item.description: 18 small business ideas you can run from home in India: pickles, masala, candles, tailoring, saree resale and more. Each one has a rough ₹ setup cost, a margin range, the licence it needs under 2026 rules, and the ODOP product it fits.

item.title: New Business Ideas in Hindi 2026: ₹2.5–20 लाख में शुरू होने वाले 15 लोकल बिज़नेस (लागत, मुनाफा और सरकारी योजनाएं)
item.description: ₹2.5–20 लाख की बचत है? UP, बिहार, MP, राजस्थान और झारखंड के 15 ODOP बिज़नेस, साथ में अनुमानित लागत, मार्जिन, PMEGP/Mudra/PMFME सब्सिडी और 90 दिन का लॉन्च प्लान।

item.title: Soap Manufacturing Process: Cold, Hot and Factory Methods, Licences, Machinery Cost and Margins in India
item.description: Soap is made by mixing oil with lye (saponification), whether you use the cold process, the hot process or a factory line of noodles, plodder and cutter. Here's how each one works, plus the COS-8 licence, 5% GST, ₹ machinery costs, PMEGP funding and realistic margins for a first-time Indian founder.

item.title: Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme Explained: Incentives, Eligibility and Where Small Suppliers Fit
item.description: On 28 October 2026 the Cabinet approved a ₹10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) running to FY 2039-40. This guide covers the funding split, the 1 lakh and 25,000 TEU thresholds, India's current container makers, and three realistic ways a first-time founder can get in.

item.title: How to Start Mushroom Farming at Home in India: ₹50k–3L Setup, Monthly Yield and Profit
item.description: Start with oyster mushrooms in one spare room. Setup costs about ₹35,000–65,000, the first harvest comes in 3–4 weeks, and you can book DMR Solan training from November 2026. Here are the room-by-room setup, a cost table, break-even maths and an honest look at morel farming.

item.title: IIPM Food Processing Unit Proposals: How to Bid for the Bengaluru RFP, Plus a PMFME Subsidy Plan for Your Own Unit
item.description: IIPM Bengaluru wants a Food Business Operator to run its incubator's food processing units, and Corrigendum-1 has extended the 25 October deadline. This guide covers how to bid, and how to plan your own micro unit with the PMFME 35% subsidy.

item.title: Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme: Eligibility, Subsidy and What Small Units Can Do Now
item.description: The Cabinet cleared the ₹1,856.67 crore Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme on 28 October 2026. You can't apply yet. Here's who qualifies, why most of the money is meant for large investors, which sports products suit a ₹2.5–20 lakh budget, and how to use PMEGP while the guidelines are pending.

item.title: Yak Churpi GI Tag: What Arunachal's Tag Covers and How to Start a Churpi Business
item.description: Only Arunachal Pradesh Yak Churpi holds a GI tag: Application 809, Certificate 511, dated 3 October 2023. Here's what the tag covers, why the November 2025 headlines confused people, and what a churpi business in West Kameng or Tawang could cost, earn and need.

item.title: 10 Ecommerce Business Ideas in India Using ODOP and GI-Tag Products (₹2.5–20L Budgets)
item.description: Skip generic dropshipping. Here are 10 ecommerce business ideas built on real district products like makhana, Araku coffee, Kalamkari and Banarasi, with estimated budgets, margins, the GST position (including the new Rule 14B) and where to sell.

item.title: Loan Waiver 2026: Does It Cover PMEGP, Mudra or MSME Business Loans?
item.description: The October 2026 loan waiver news is about Maharashtra crop loans. PMEGP, Mudra and CGTMSE business loans are not covered and are not waived. Here's how the PMEGP subsidy actually works, and what to do if you can't keep up with EMIs.

item.title: 12 Transport Business Ideas in India for ₹2.5–20 Lakh: EV Rickshaws, Mini Trucks, Cold Chain and More
item.description: Twelve transport business ideas you can start with ₹2.5–20 lakh, from e-rickshaws and mini trucks to reefer vans for ODOP clusters. Includes Mudra loan routes, sample EMIs, current subsidies and the permits you need.

item.title: Business Ideas for Women at Home: 9 ODOP-Linked Options With ₹ Costs, Margins and Schemes (2026)
item.description: Nine home businesses women can actually start in 2026, from pickles and millet snacks to crochet and Bandhani. Each one comes with setup costs, margins, breakeven months and a check on which schemes (PMEGP, MUDRA, Lakhpati Didi) you can apply for today.

item.title: 8 Small Manufacturing Business Ideas in India Under ₹20 Lakh (With PMEGP Subsidy and ODOP Clusters)
item.description: Eight manufacturing units a first-time founder can actually set up for ₹3–20 lakh, from areca leaf plates to corrugated boxes. Each one comes with machinery cost, break-even, matching ODOP districts and PMEGP/PMFME subsidy maths.

item.title: I Want to Start a Business but Have No Ideas? A 5-Step Way to Find One From Your Own District
item.description: If you want to start a business but have no ideas, skip the lists of 100 random ideas. Start with your budget, your district's ODOP product and your own skills, and you can get to two or three realistic ideas, with PMEGP subsidy maths worked out.

item.title: 20 Business Ideas in Bihar You Can Start with ₹2.5–20 Lakh: District ODOP Picks, Costs and Schemes
item.description: Twenty Bihar business ideas, one or more per district, based on each district's ODOP product: makhana in Saharsa, silk in Bhagalpur, jute in Katihar, lemongrass in Aurangabad and more. Each comes with an estimated setup cost, margin and the scheme that fits it, as of 28 October 2026.

item.title: 15 Business Ideas in Bangalore You Can Start with ₹2.5–20 Lakh (Costs, Margins, Schemes)
item.description: With ₹2.5–20 lakh, the best business ideas in Bangalore build on the district's ODOP strengths (garments, silk sarees, IT services) or on the city's demand for food and EVs. Here are 15 ideas with costs, margins and licence rules, plus the KSWDC deadline of 31 October and the ELEVATE grant deadline of 13 November 2026.

item.title: 15 Business Ideas in Mumbai You Can Start with ₹2.5–20 Lakh (Costs, Margins, Schemes)
item.description: Fifteen business ideas in Mumbai, each with a setup cost by suburb, a margin range, the licences you need and a way to fund it through Mudra, PMEGP or CMEGP. Covers cloud kitchens, Crawford Market garment trading and Bhiwandi warehousing.
